headline: A 1998 executive order by President Clinton dealing with the spread of weapons of mass destruction.
what_it_does: This order deals with the spread of weapons of mass destruction, such as nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons. No summary was provided, so its exact rules cannot be confirmed here. Orders on this topic generally set federal policy and may allow penalties against foreign parties that help other countries get these weapons.
